drivingQuestion: Do the mishna's four cubits apply in every direction?
outcomeNote: A transmitted qualification of the mishna; the challenge to it opens only in the next unit.

segments.he: כַּמָּה יַרְחִיק מֵהֶן וּמִן הַצּוֹאָה — אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת. אָמַר רָבָא אָמַר רַב סְחוֹרָה אָמַר רַב הוּנָא: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא לַאֲחוֹרָיו, אֲבָל לְפָנָיו — מַרְחִיק מְלֹא עֵינָיו, וְכֵן לִתְפִלָּה.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: «And, how far must one distance himself from urine and from feces» in order to recite Shema? «Four cubits. Rava said» that «Rav Seḥora said» that «Rav Huna said: They only taught» that it is sufficient to distance oneself four cubits when the feces are «behind him, but» if they are «before him he must distance himself» to the point that it is «no longer within his range of vision;» and the halakha «is the same» for «prayer.»

moves.summary: quotes the mishna clause on distancing
moves.about: the mishna's requirement to distance oneself four cubits from urine and feces

moves.cueHe: אמר רבא אמר רב סחורה אמר רב הונא
moves.summary: through a chain of tradents: four cubits only behind him, in front as far as the eye sees, and so too for prayer
moves.about: the mishna's four cubits were taught only where the feces are behind him; in front of him he must distance himself as far as his eye can see

edges.cueHe: כמה ירחיק מהן ומן הצואה — ארבע אמות
edges.about: the mishna's requirement to distance oneself four cubits from urine and feces
the qualification that four cubits suffice only when the feces are behind him

edges.cueHe: אמר רב סחורה אמר רב הונא

edges.cueHe: לא שנו אלא לאחוריו, אבל לפניו — מרחיק מלא עיניו
edges.about: the mishna's four cubits were taught only where the feces are behind him; in front of him he must distance himself as far as his eye can see
the same measure of distance governs the Amida prayer and not only the recitation of Shema
